mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals WHERE 1=1 AND account_id=#{account_id} AND table_id=#{table_id} AND table_year=#{table_year} AND table_month=#{table_month} AND table_week=#{table_week} AND meal_plan_type=#{meal_plan_type} ORDER BY table_year DESC,table_month DESC,table_week DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals(table_id,account_id,account_name,table_name,table_year,table_month,table_week,meal_plan_type,status,user_id)VALUES(#{table_id},#{account_id},#{account_name},#{table_name},#{table_year},#{table_month},#{table_week},COALESCE(#{meal_plan_type},0),COALESCE(#{status},'DRAFT'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_name=VALUES(account_name),table_name=VALUES(table_name),meal_plan_type=VALUES(meal_plan_type),status=VALUES(status),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT s.*,COALESCE(SUM(c.cost_per_person),0) meal_cost_per_person FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_menu_cost_snapshot c ON c.meal_service_id=s.meal_service_id WHERE 1=1 AND s.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND s.table_id=#{table_id} AND s.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY s.meal_service_id ORDER BY s.meal_date,s.meal_slot
SELECT budget_per_person,budget_source,budget_source_amount,budget_divisor FROM the_full_order.vw_account_meal_slot_budget WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND meal_slot_code=#{meal_slot_code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service(table_id,account_id,meal_date,weekday,meal_slot,meal_slot_code,food_type,meal_plan_type,template_id,planned_servings,actual_servings,meal_budget_per_person,budget_source,budget_source_amount,budget_divisor,status,user_id)VALUES(#{table_id},#{account_id},#{meal_date},#{weekday},#{meal_slot},#{meal_slot_code},#{food_type},COALESCE(#{meal_plan_type},0),#{template_id},#{planned_servings},#{actual_servings},#{meal_budget_per_person},#{budget_source},#{budget_source_amount},#{budget_divisor},COALESCE(#{status},'DRAFT'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE meal_service_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(meal_service_id),weekday=VALUES(weekday),meal_slot_code=VALUES(meal_slot_code),food_type=VALUES(food_type),meal_plan_type=VALUES(meal_plan_type),template_id=VALUES(template_id),planned_servings=VALUES(planned_servings),actual_servings=VALUES(actual_servings),meal_budget_per_person=VALUES(meal_budget_per_person),budget_source=VALUES(budget_source),budget_source_amount=VALUES(budget_source_amount),budget_divisor=VALUES(budget_divisor),status=VALUES(status),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT d.*,s.meal_date,s.weekday,s.meal_slot,s.meal_slot_code,s.food_type AS service_food_type,s.meal_plan_type,s.template_id,s.planned_servings,s.meal_budget_per_person,s.budget_source,s.budget_source_amount,s.budget_divisor,t.account_name,t.table_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s ON s.meal_service_id=d.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=d.table_id WHERE 1=1 AND d.meal_detail_id=#{meal_detail_id} AND d.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND d.table_id=#{table_id} AND d.account_id=#{account_id} ORDER BY s.meal_date,s.meal_slot,d.sort_order

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=s.account_id AND m.menu_id=#{menu_id} AND m.del_yn='N' WHERE s.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND s.account_id=#{account_id} AND s.meal_plan_type=m.meal_plan_type

SELECT s.meal_service_id,s.meal_budget_per_person,s.budget_source, COUNT(DISTINCT d.meal_detail_id) AS menu_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.recipe_count > 0 THEN d.meal_detail_id END) AS recipe_menu_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.recipe_count),0) AS ingredient_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.priced_count),0) AS priced_ingredient_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.menu_cost),0),4) AS meal_cost_per_person FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d ON d.meal_service_id=s.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rd.account_id,rd.menu_id,COUNT(*) AS recipe_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rd.qty_per_person > 0 AND sp.supplier_product_id IS NOT NULL AND sp.base_qty > 0 AND ph.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND ph.purchase_price > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rd.qty_per_person > 0 AND sp.supplier_product_id IS NOT NULL AND sp.base_qty > 0 AND ph.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND ph.purchase_price > 0 THEN rd.qty_per_person*ph.purchase_price/sp.base_qty ELSE 0 END) AS menu_cost FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp ON sp.supplier_product_id=( SELECT ap.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp2 ON sp2.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id WHERE ap.account_id=rd.account_id AND sp2.ingredient_id=rd.ingredient_id AND ap.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY ap.preferred_yn DESC,ap.account_ingredient_product_id LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_from<=NOW() AND (ph.effective_to IS NULL OR ph.effective_to>NOW()) GROUP BY rd.account_id,rd.menu_id ) r ON r.account_id=d.account_id AND r.menu_id=d.menu_id WHERE s.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} GROUP BY s.meal_service_id,s.meal_budget_per_person,s.budget_source
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail(meal_service_id,table_id,account_id,sort_order,menu_id,menu_name,food_type,menu_type,menu_gubun,user_id)VALUES(#{meal_service_id},#{table_id},#{account_id},COALESCE(#{sort_order},0),#{menu_id},#{menu_name},#{food_type},#{menu_type},#{menu_gubun},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE menu_name=VALUES(menu_name),food_type=VALUES(food_type),menu_type=VALUES(menu_type),menu_gubun=VALUES(menu_gubun),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_menu_cost_snapshot WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT r.*,i.ingredient_name_std,p.product_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id WHERE r.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} ORDER BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement(meal_service_id,menu_id,ingredient_id,supplier_product_id,qty_per_person,planned_servings,total_required_qty,base_unit,package_price_snapshot,package_base_qty_snapshot,calculated_cost) SELECT d.meal_service_id,d.menu_id,r.ingredient_id,sp.supplier_product_id,r.qty_per_person,s.planned_servings,r.qty_per_person*s.planned_servings,r.base_unit,ph.purchase_price,sp.base_qty,ROUND(ph.purchase_price*(r.qty_per_person*s.planned_servings)/NULLIF(sp.base_qty,0),4) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s ON s.meal_service_id=d.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r ON r.account_id=d.account_id AND r.menu_id=d.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp ON sp.supplier_product_id=(SELECT ap2.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap2 JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp2 ON sp2.supplier_product_id=ap2.supplier_product_id WHERE ap2.account_id=d.account_id AND sp2.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id AND ap2.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY ap2.preferred_yn DESC,ap2.account_ingredient_product_id LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_from<=NOW() AND (ph.effective_to IS NULL OR ph.effective_to>NOW()) WHERE d.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id}

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_meal_menu_cost_snapshot(meal_service_id,menu_id,sort_order,cost_per_person,total_cost) SELECT r.meal_service_id,r.menu_id,d.sort_order,ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.calculated_cost,0))/NULLIF(MAX(r.planned_servings),0),4),ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.calculated_cost,0)),2) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d ON d.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id AND d.menu_id=r.menu_id WHERE r.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} GROUP BY r.meal_service_id,r.menu_id,d.sort_order
